literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1–L3) describe the same GFP-MS4A4A construct cloned into pEGFP-C1, which fuses EGFP to the N-terminus of MS4A4A. The topology landmarks place the MS4A4A N-terminus (residues 1–64) in the intracellular compartment, and the C-terminus (residues 201–239) is likewise intracellular. Both extracellular loops (ECL1: 86–101, ECL2: 156–185) are not addressed by any ledger line — no insertion, tag, or transposon screen is reported in either loop. The GFP fusion is therefore an intracellular N-terminal tag; it demonstrates proper plasma-membrane trafficking but does not constitute evidence for an extracellular surface tag. No ledger line grounds any extracellular tag site, so sites = [].

literature_other_positions.note: GFP fused to the N-terminus of MS4A4A via pEGFP-C1; the N-terminus (residues 1–64) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so GFP faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space. Plasma-membrane localization of the full-length fusion was confirmed (L2), but the tag is not on the surface.
